name: netwave
description: Network scattering-parameter math for node + browser (single package, exports conditions)

scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.mjs -o dist --format esm && napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.cjs -o dist --format commonjs && node scripts/publish_shell.mjs
scripts.build:native:debug: napi build --platform --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.mjs -o dist --format esm && napi build --platform --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.cjs -o dist --format commonjs && node scripts/publish_shell.mjs
